text: dsh-model-capabilities 为 DSH Web 与 Desktop 添加模型设置页面，在 Settings 插槽显示各 provider 的模型和覆盖项。用户可逐项配置 text/image 输入模态，以及是否启用推理和各推理级别的 wire 值，再通过 llm-pi-ai 设置接口保存。适合需要集中维护模型能力的用户；需要已有 llm-pi-ai 模型配置，不需额外 API 密钥。

dsh-model-capabilities adds a DSH settings page to edit text/image inputs and reasoning levels for configured models, including custom wire values. Changes save to llm-pi-ai settings. It requires an existing model configuration.
想在 DSH 里给不同模型分别设置文本或图像输入能力。
怎样为各个模型配置不同的推理等级和对应参数值？
I want one settings page to edit input modes and reasoning options for all configured models.
dsh-model-capabilities 的功能「逐模型输入模态」：在设置页面查看 provider 下的模型和覆盖项，并为每个模型设置继承或自定义的 text/image 输入类型；保存时写入 llm-pi-ai 设置。
dsh-model-capabilities 的功能「推理级别配置」：可为模型选择继承、关闭推理或配置推理级别，并填写各级别对应的 wire 值；页面验证后通过设置接口保存更改。

dsh-model-capabilities README · dsh-model-capabilities：A **DeepSeek Harness** plugin that lets you edit each model's **input modalities** (`input: ["text", "image"]`) and per-model **`reasoningEfforts`** directly from the Settings UI — no hand-editing `settings.yaml`.

It works on **DSH Web** and **DSH Desktop**: Desktop runs the same web bundle in compatibility mode on the same profile, so no extra registration is needed.

dsh-model-capabilities README · dsh-model-capabilities：> **How this relates to [`WJZ-P/dsh-model-capabilities`](https://github.com/WJZ-P/dsh-model-capabilities) (`dsh-model-capability`)**: that plugin adds a single *input-type* selector into the native Models editor. This package is a **complement, not a clone** — it adds the two things that plugin (and the built-in Models page) leave out:
>
> * **`reasoningEfforts`** (per-level reasoning wiring: `minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max` + `off`, with custom wire values) — WJZ-P's plugin does not cover reasoning at all.
> * A **whole-profile, batch view**: it enumerates every configured model under *both* `providers.<route>.models[]` **and** `providers.<route>.modelOverrides` at once, so you can review and write to all of them from one place.
>
> If you only need the `input: text/image` picker while adding a model, WJZ-P's inline field is the lighter choice; if you also need reasoning wiring and a full overview of configured models (incl. overrides), this package is what you want.

dsh-model-capabilities README · What it adds：- Lists every configured provider and its models (`providers.<route>.models[]` and `providers.<route>.modelOverrides`).
- Lets you toggle `input` modalities (`text`, `image`) per model.
- Lets you set `reasoningEfforts` per model:
  - **Non-reasoning** → writes `reasoningEfforts: false`.
  - **Reasoning** → fill a wire value per level (`minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max`); `off` may be left empty (send no reasoning parameter). At least one non-`off` level must be filled.
- Writes straight through the existing `llm-pi-ai` settings namespace (`settings.mutate`), so the running `llm-pi-ai` adapter re-registers routes and the model picker shows the new reasoning levels immediately, and the change persists to `settings.yaml`.

dsh-model-capabilities README · What it adds：The existing built-in "Models" page intentionally does **not** expose these two per-model fields (reasoning is a per-model capability); this plugin fills exactly that gap with a dedicated page.

dsh-model-capabilities README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-model-capabilities

dsh-model-capabilities README · then restart DSH (web or desktop) to load the new bundle：```

`dsh plugin add` installs the package into the profile (`profiles/<name>/node_modules`), appends it to `dsh.profile.bundles`, and applies the package's `cordis.patch.yml` (which activates the minimal host entry that the client-modules node half needs to discover and serve the browser bundle).

1. Put the built package under `profiles/<name>/node_modules/dsh-model-capabilities/`.
2. Add `"dsh-model-capabilities"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in `profiles/<name>/package.json`.
3. Restart DSH.

dsh-model-capabilities README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> remove dsh-model-capabilities
```

Or remove it from `dsh.profile.bundles` (and the following unneeded entry in your profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: model-capabilities
  disabled: true   # or delete this block entirely
```

dsh-model-capabilities README · Build (from source)：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build      # tsdown → lib/client.js (client-modules format) ; lib/index.js is hand-written
```

Prerequisites: Node ^22.19 / >=24 and pnpm. `tsdown` must be >= 0.22 (older 0.7.x ships a rolldown that fails to expose `transformPlugin`).

dsh-model-capabilities README · Requirements & behavior notes：- The section reads/writes the `llm-pi-ai` settings namespace. If no provider/model is configured yet (the section would be empty), add one under the built-in **Models** page first.
- Validation mirrors the `llm-pi-ai` schema (`MODALITIES = [text, image]`; `THINKING_LEVELS = [off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max]`; `reasoningEfforts` is `false` or a `{level → string|null}` map with only `off` allowed empty). Invalid values are rejected client-side, and the host schema re-validates as the final guard.
- On a read-only connection the page shows a notice and disables saving.
- Write conflicts (stale revision) are surfaced and the page refreshes for a retry.
